title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Play Rock Paper Scissors with the person to your right.

title: Thumb War
description: Challenge someone to a 1-minute thumb war.

title: Memory Challenge
description: Look at 5 items for 10 seconds, close your eyes, and name them.

title: Categories
description: Pick a category. Go around naming things in it until someone fails.

title: Rhyme Game
description: Say a word. The next person rhymes it. Go until someone fails.

title: Guess the Song
description: Hum a song and the group has to guess it.

title: Charades Quickie
description: Act out an animal. First person to guess wins.

title: Never Have I Ever
description: Say something you've never done. Anyone who has must put a finger down.

title: Two Truths One Lie
description: Tell 2 truths and 1 lie. The group must guess the lie.

title: Word Association
description: Say a word, next person says the first word they think of. Go fast!

title: Would You Rather
description: Ask the group a difficult Would You Rather question.

title: Alphabet Game
description: Pick a topic. Go around naming things A-Z.

title: Staring Contest Tournament
description: Challenge two people to a staring contest.

title: Truth or Dare Quickie
description: Pick one person and ask them Truth or Dare.

title: Guess the Movie
description: Describe a movie plot terribly. The group must guess it.

title: The Floor is Lava
description: Last person to get their feet off the floor loses.

title: Name That Tune
description: Play 3 seconds of a song on your phone. First to guess wins.

title: Blind Drawing
description: Close your eyes and draw a house. The group rates it.

title: Tongue Twister
description: Say 'She sells seashells by the seashore' 5 times fast.

title: Don't Blink
description: First person to blink in the room loses.

title: Statue Maker
description: Pose the person to your left like a statue.

title: Mirror Game
description: Person to your left must mirror all your movements for 30s.

title: Try Not To Laugh
description: You have 30 seconds to make the person across from you laugh.

title: Hide and Seek
description: Hide an object in the room. The group has 1 minute to find it.

title: Hot Potato
description: Pass an object around while music plays. Stop the music. Whoever holds it loses.

title: Story Time
description: Build a story one word at a time around the circle.

title: Whisper Challenge
description: Whisper a phrase to someone wearing headphones. They must guess it.

title: Quick Sketch
description: Draw a dog in 10 seconds. Best drawing wins.

title: Math Race
description: Give a math problem. First to answer wins.

title: Capital Cities
description: Name as many capital cities as you can in 20 seconds.
